name: storylark
description: StoryLark — installable PWA for branded story libraries (read + listen + offline + sync)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w app -- --mode storylark && wrangler dev --env storylark
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env storylark
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p app/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit
